description: This file extends jQuery with methods related to dimension calculations such as height, width, innerHeight, outerHeight, etc. It defines methods on the jQuery prototype to get or set element dimensions, considering margins, borders, and padding.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Gets or sets the height of the selected elements, optionally including padding, border, or margin.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Gets or sets the width of the selected elements, optionally including padding, border, or margin.

methods.name: innerHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the element including padding.

methods.name: innerWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the element including padding.

methods.name: outerHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the element including padding, border, and optionally margin.

methods.name: outerWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the element including padding, border, and optionally margin.
